summary: Frontend-only visual regression check on Elvora-X 'Our Collection'. Verified the three Home Care product images (Forest Blossom, Forest Dew, Royal Forest) plus the Automobile card (Car Dashboard Polish) render the full bottle without clipping using object-contain, load successfully (complete=true, naturalWidth>0, no 404), and are centered with vertical padding inside the 380px card image area. Also verified the filter toggle (all/home-care/automobile), product modal open (product-card-forest-blossom -> product-modal) and close (modal-close). All checks PASS.

filter_toggle.filter-home-care: only home-care visible; automobile removed from DOM

critical_code_review_comments: Products.jsx modal image for non-photo products uses fixed h-[300px] which is fine, but the modal outer container uses 'items-end' — since object-contain is used it renders correctly, but 'items-center' would be more intuitive.

The card image container height 380px combined with tall bottle aspect ratios (e.g., Forest Dew 264x1056 ~ 1:4) results in very narrow rendered widths (85px). This is not a bug but could look small; consider slightly reducing bottle image whitespace or increasing card height for visual balance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for cropped Home Care product images is verified fixed. All 4 product card images use object-contain and preserve natural aspect ratio inside the 380px container with py-5. Modal also uses object-contain. Filter toggle uses conditional rendering (elements removed from DOM), not just hidden.
